svg.title: SCP FinOps — from allocation and usage to verified optimization
svg.desc: Azure Cost Management, Prometheus and Resource Graph feed a weekly Azure Function. Azure OpenAI correlates allocation, usage and cost to recommend right-sizing, scheduling or SKU changes. Cosmos DB stores results for a report or portal. Applying a right-sizing recommendation creates a GitHub pull request, which the customer reviews and merges before GitHub Actions and Terraform update the workload. The system observes CPU limits, OOM events and latency for 48 hours before reporting the outcome.
